start: Trainers, 'Personal training this week'; a member has personal-training classes left; a trainer has a free slot later today

steps.action: Tap a 'Free' cell in that trainer’s column
user_sees: Sheet 'Book personal training'
Under 'Member': a search box 'Search name' and the members who have classes left, each with their classes-left words
'Trainer', 'Day', 'Start time' and 'How long' already set from the cell
'<trainer>, <Day>: <working hours>'
'Booking does not use up a class. Tap "Mark session" on the member’s page when they come.'
must_not: A different trainer, day or time than the tapped cell
Archived members in the list

user_sees: The member’s name, a pill with the classes left, how many are already booked, and 'Change member'
must_not: Classes left that differ from the member’s own page

user_sees: The button reads 'Booking…' and cannot be pressed again
The sheet closes; note 'Booked: <member> with <trainer>, <day>, <from–to>.'
The grid shows the member’s name in those half-hour rows; the day chip count is one higher
must_not: Two bookings from one tap
A class used up by booking
The 'Booked' note when the server refused

start: Other entry: the button 'Book personal training' under the grid, and 'Book with <name>' on a trainer’s page

user_sees: The same sheet with the first trainer, today (or the picked later day), and 'Start time' on 'Pick a time'
must_not: A past day preset when a past day is picked in the grid

steps.action: On a trainer’s page tap 'Book with <name>'
user_sees: The sheet with that trainer preset, today when this week is shown, 'Pick a time'
must_not: When a past week is shown on the trainer’s page: a 'Day' list that holds only a day already over, so no booking can be made (seen in the code: Trainers.tsx:902 with 548-549; see the finding)

steps.action: Pick member, time and length, tap 'Book'
user_sees: Note 'Booked: <member> with <trainer>, <day>, <from–to>.'
must_not: A booking on a day the sheet did not show

start: Other kind: a time outside the trainer’s working hours ('Book anyway', Trainers.tsx:609)

steps.action: Pick a start time outside the trainer’s hours and tap 'Book'
user_sees: Red box 'This is outside <trainer>’s working hours. Press "Book anyway" if <trainer> agreed.'
The main button now reads 'Book anyway'
must_not: The booking saved without the question
The question for a trainer whose hours are not set (every time is open)

user_sees: Note 'Booked: <member> with <trainer>, <day>, <from–to>.'; the name shows in the grid
must_not: 'Book anyway' still armed after the time or trainer was changed to one inside the hours

start: Negative: every refusal of the booking sheet

steps.action: Tap 'Book' with no member picked, then with a member but 'Pick a time'
user_sees: 'Pick the member first.'
'Pick a start time.'
must_not: A booking with no member or no time

steps.action: Pick today and a time already gone; then a day more than 31 days ahead
user_sees: 'This time has already passed. Pick a time later than now.'
'You can book at most 31 days ahead.'
must_not: A booking in the past

steps.action: Pick a member with no classes left; then one whose classes left are all booked
user_sees: '<name> has no personal-training classes left. Sell a personal-training plan first.'
'All <n> of <name>’s personal-training classes left are already booked. Sell more first, or cancel a booking.'
must_not: More bookings ahead than classes left

steps.action: Pick a time when the trainer, or the member, is already booked
user_sees: '<trainer> already has <member> at <time>. Pick another time.'
'<member> is already booked at <time> that day. Pick another time.'
must_not: Two members in one trainer’s slot
One member with two trainers at once

steps.action: Search a name nobody has; clear the search in a gym where nobody has classes left
user_sees: 'No member with this name.'
'No member has personal-training classes left. Search by name to find anyone.'
must_not: An empty list with no words

steps.action: Book a member, then open the booking and cancel it
user_sees: The slot reads 'Free' again; the day chip count is one lower
must_not: The cancelled booking still counted against the member’s classes left to book

steps.action: Book the same member into the same slot again
user_sees: Note 'Booked: …' and the name back in the grid
must_not: '<member> is already booked at <time> that day' because of the cancelled booking

steps.action: Open the sheet, press 'Cancel' instead of 'Book'
user_sees: The sheet closes; the grid is unchanged
must_not: A booking saved by Cancel

start: Privacy and promise: what a booking stores and who sees it

steps.action: Book a member, then open the booking as another desk person
user_sees: 'Booked by <name>' of the person who booked; the member’s name and classes left
must_not: A booking with no trace of who made it
The member’s phone number on the booking

steps.action: Look at the member app of that member
user_sees: unknown: whether the member sees the booking in the app was not read
must_not: Another member’s booking shown to this member
